simple.meaning: כַּסְלֻחִים (Kaçluchîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “Casluchim , a people cognate to the Egyptians.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כַּסְלֻחִים (H3695) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:14, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּסְלֻחִים (H3695) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כַּסְלֻחִים (H3695) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כַּסְלֻחִים (Kaçluchîym) / H3695 is traced through Genesis 10:14, 1 Chronicles 1:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
